title: fix(post): retract Z before a later tool change's G49 (mazak, fanuc, doosan)
body:
Supersedes #4371 (take-over, author mkinney; commits kept). This branch starts from the #4371 head `ce23fdaa8`. It then has one merge of `origin/main` and one fix commit. There is no rebase and no force-push.

## What changed

- The Mazak, Fanuc and Doosan DNM posts lift Z before the preamble of each section after the first (commit `ce23fdaa8`, mkinney).
- The lift uses the `safeRetract` method of the post: `G91 G28 Z0` (default) or `G53 G00 Z<safeRetractZ>`.
- The lift comes immediately before the `G90 ... G49 G80` block. The `G90` of that block ends the `G91` of the `G28` lift. `T M6` and `G43 H` follow as before.
- The first section gets no lift. Single-tool programs do not change.
- A Go home or a setup-change lift already raises Z. The post then writes no second lift (`zUp` flag).
- Fanuc and Doosan: a tilted section leaves `G43.4` armed until the next `G49`. The post then writes `G49` before the lift, in the same order as its Go home. The upright return after a tilt (#3466) does not write its own lift now.

## Take-over work (the findings of the review of `ce23fdaa8`)

1. **Stale recorded program, red suite.** `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/multiaxis_deburr_tilthead.nc` is regenerated (see "Recorded programs moved").
   - Class rule: I ran each `camcraft-app` suite with `WRITE_GOLDEN=1`, and `cargo xtask catalog --case` for each red catalog case and for the two heavy catalog cases.
   - Then a script read each tracked `.nc` file. It found no Fanuc, Mazak or Doosan program that has a later `G49 G80` block without a lift before it. The programs that it still finds are Tormach and Haas programs. Those posts are out of scope (follow-up #4372).
2. **Conflict with main.** I merged `origin/main` into the branch. Main changed the same preamble lines:
   - `fanuc.cps`, `doosan-dnm.cps`: main (#4346) added `G17 G94` to the preamble block. The merge keeps the #4341 lift before the block and the #4346 words in the block.
   - Main (#4348) added its own `tcpmLeft` flag for the program end. The two changes use the one flag: the section end sets it, and the next preamble or `onClose` reads it. The merge keeps the one declaration of main and removes the duplicate declaration of #4371.
   - Main moved the post test files into directory suites. The two new test files of #4371 moved with them: `crates/post/tests/script_wcs/setup_change/tool_change_retract.rs` and `crates/post/tests/script_rotary/upright_after_tilt/tool_change_retract.rs`.
   - Recorded programs: the merge takes the text of main, and the fix commit regenerates them.
3. **Notes (not blocking), also done.**
   - The decision record now has the setup-change stop case after a tilted section, and the shared `tcpmLeft` flag.
   - `assets/posts/AGENTS.md` ("The laws every post states") now states the lift.

## Recorded programs moved

All are Fanuc programs, because the default post is Fanuc. No Mazak or Doosan recorded program has a later section. Each `+n` is `n` new `G91 G28 Z0` lines. Each new line is between the `(OPERATION: ...)` note and the `G90 G17 G94 G54 G40 G49 G80` block of a later section. No other line changes.

- `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/multiaxis_deburr_tilthead.nc`:
  - section 2 (after an upright section): +1.
  - section 3 (after the tilted section): the order changes from `G90 G17 G94 G54 G40 G49 G80` / `G91 G28 Z0` / `G90` to `G49` / `G91 G28 Z0` / `G90 G17 G94 G54 G40 G49 G80`. `G00 A0. B0.` follows as before. TCPM is off before the `G28`, and Z is up before the preamble block.
- `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/pattern_folder/fanuc_grid_by_part.nc` (+6). This file is new on main since #4371.
- `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/pattern_folder/fanuc_linear_by_tool.nc` (+2). This file is new on main since #4371.
- `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/program_entry/fanuc_pause_home.nc` (+1)
- `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/thread_mill_external_m8_multi_form.nc` (+1)
- `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/thread_mill_m8_multi_form.nc` (+1)
- `examples/first-part.nc` (+2), regenerated with `camcraft-cli process`
- `examples/catalog/2d/adaptive-pocket/adaptive-pocket.nc` (+1)
- `examples/catalog/2d/edge-work/edge-work.nc` (+3)
- `examples/catalog/2d/first-part/first-part.nc` (+2)
- `examples/catalog/2d/hole-work/hole-work.nc` (+4)
- `examples/catalog/2d/slots/slots.nc` (+1)
- `examples/catalog/3d/rest/rest.nc` (+1). This case is new on main since #4371.
- `examples/catalog/3d/rough-finish/rough-finish.nc` (+2)
- `examples/catalog/probing/probe-face/probe-face.nc` (+1)
- `examples/catalog/multiaxis/indexed/indexed.nc`: two places change in the same way as section 3 of the deburr program. They change from `G90 G17 G94 G54 G40 G49 G80` / `G91 G28 Z0` / `G90` to `G49` / `G91 G28 Z0` / `G90 G17 G94 G54 G40 G49 G80`.

The regeneration also rewrote some files that this fix does not change. I reverted them, and they are not in this PR:
- `.camproj` files: the project `version` changed from 83 to 84.
- `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/tormach/wrap_rotary_parallel_microarc4.nc`, `examples/first-continuous-4axis-part.nc`, `docs/tester-kits/*.camproj`, `examples/first-4axis-part.camproj`, `examples/first-router-part.camproj`: the last digit of some A words and feeds changed (for example `A-39.432` to `A-39.431`). The Tormach post is not changed. The suites of these files pass on the committed text.

`crates/app/tests/program_entry.rs`: `z_homes` counts trip homes. It does not count the new lift immediately before a preamble `G49` line. The tests keep their intent (commit `ce23fdaa8`).

## Tests

Pinning tests:
- `script_wcs`: `setup_change::tool_change_retract::mazak_fanuc_doosan_retract_z_before_a_second_tool_g28`
- `script_wcs`: `setup_change::tool_change_retract::mazak_fanuc_doosan_retract_z_before_a_second_tool_g53`
- `script_wcs`: `setup_change::tool_change_retract::mazak_fanuc_doosan_retract_z_before_the_same_tool_called_again`
- `script_wcs`: `setup_change::tool_change_retract::a_trip_home_is_not_followed_by_a_second_retract`
- `script_wcs`: `setup_change::tool_change_retract::a_setup_change_stop_is_not_followed_by_a_second_retract`
- `script_rotary`: `upright_after_tilt::tool_change_retract::fanuc_and_doosan_cancel_tcpm_before_the_tool_change_retract`
- `app`: `mcp_multiaxis_deburr_post` (`the_three_section_tilthead_program_matches_its_golden`), the suite that was red in the review.

The #4371 body records the red-before-fix check and the mutation results. The review of `ce23fdaa8` repeated the mutations.

Gates on the final head (`4f6526650`):
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: 723 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled. The step `site tests (python unittest, zola, node)` is SKIP (zola and node are not installed on this host). This is not a pass. The post suites `script_wcs` and `script_rotary` and each `camcraft-app` suite are in the plan.
- Example catalog suites: `app suites: example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`, `first_part_programs`: pass (in the quick plan).
- `cargo xtask gate light`: 4 steps, 0 failed.
- Targeted heavy step (P1 under the safety floor): `cargo xtask gate heavy --base origin/main --only "app heavy: example_catalog"`: 1 step, 0 failed. It holds the heavy tests of the recorded programs that this fix moves: `catalog_2d_slots::{regenerates,rebuilds}` and `catalog_2d_adaptive_pocket::{regenerates,rebuilds}`, 4 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- The first two quick runs stopped at `post build (--no-run)` with E0463 (stale build artifacts of `camcraft-geometry`, `camcraft-cl` and `camcraft-kernel`). I did not change code between the runs. I ran `cargo clean -p` on those crates and ran the gate again with `CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1`.

## Not exercised

- No run on a Mazak, Fanuc or Doosan control.
- After a tilted section, the post writes `G49` before the lift, as its Go home did before. On a control where `G49` alone moves Z, that `G49` still runs before the lift. It is in the same place as before this PR. The post does not lift first, because a reference return under TCPM can alarm.
- No Mazak golden program with two tools. The word-level pins cover the order. The review of `ce23fdaa8` accepted this.
- Haas, Tormach and LinuxCNC also write `G49` in each section preamble. They are out of the scope of this issue (#4372).
- `crates/ui/tests/catalog_render.rs` and the site tests did not run.

Decision record: `docs/decisions/4341-mazak-retract-before-toolchange.md`.

Effort: high (no escalation)

Changelog: The Mazak, Fanuc and Doosan DNM posts lift Z by the safe retract method before each later tool change, so the G49 of the next preamble never runs at the clearance height of the previous operation.

Fixes #4341
